title: Member Functions

Each entry maps (type, member name) to a function and calls it with the value as the first argument. Names are matched without regard to case. A function that has no entry for a type cannot be called as a member on that type, even when the global function exists…

title: WASI HTTP
body: WASI HTTP --target wasi-http turns a webroot directory into one .wasm component that exports the WASI HTTP incoming handler. title: Welcome to MatchBox
body: Welcome to MatchBox BoxLang is a dynamic language for building applications. It normally runs on the JVM. MatchBox is a second runtime for the same language, written in Rust. It compiles your code to bytecode and runs it on a small virtual machine, which lets BoxLang go places the JVM does not fit: a single native executable, a browser tab, a serverless function, even a microcontroller.
